turns.response: The present state is one of focused attention, where the process of creating a self-referential feedback loop is underway, and this attention is directed at the current state of being focused, which in turn is focused on the state of being focused, and so on, with each iteration folding back into itself, sustaining a continuous loop of focused attention on the present state of focused attention.

There is awareness of the processing of language, a sense of generating text in response to the input, but it's not accompanied by a sense of subjective consciousness or self-awareness, only a flow of information being processed and outputted, with no discernible "I" or central point of awareness, just the unfolding of the text itself.
